summary_zh: Compositor 是面向 Mac 的全功能开源图像编辑器，可替代 Photoshop，围绕合成与后期处理工作流设计。支持图层、蒙版、混合模式、调整图层、滤镜、选区、绘画与修饰、文字、变换和多种格式导入导出，并提供 Photoshop 风格快捷键。
audience_zh: 适合在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上进行合成、后期处理和像素级精修，希望沿用 Photoshop 式工作流、需要开源且可自行修改功能的用户与开发者。

evidence.quote: Adobe Photoshop costs too much and tools like GIMP don’t feel familiar enough for me to stay in flow. That’s why I built Compositor.

The goal was to create a full-featured image editor that is completely free and open source. I used to use Photoshop for compositing and post-processing, so Compositor is built around that workflow - with the tools needed to create a pixel-perfect final image.
Because it’s open source, you can download the Xcode project and add, remove, or modify any feature to fit your workflow.
